The student council group "STARS", the sporty team "Queen's Quest", the fearsome crew "Oedo-tai", the dancing gals "Donna del Mondo", and the idol candidates "Cosmic Angels". As each unit comes together, what kind of school life will unfold? The gong for the start of school is about to sound!!! Powered by STARDOM

134086.description:
Kou, a party-goer college student, leads a flashy campus life. Yet he's actually an unassuming guy and, secretly, a closeted gay otaku. His goal is to "get a fashionable boyfriend!!!" Unfortunately, he's never met anyone, nor has the courage to come out. Then one day, Tanaka, whom Kou meets at his favorite game store, suddenly confesses to him. Tanaka is a fellow otaku and the two have a great affinity, but what if Kou simply isn't willing to accept his dull and tacky appearance...? The happiest, most bittersweet coming-of-age love comedy, dedicated to all otakus who hate themselves and want to change!

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

134087.description:
Shiina and Aoi are a romantic Alpha and Omega couple who live happily together with their little son, Noel. Protected and sheltered by his parents, Noel is unaware that his family is different from any other until he one day accompanies Shiina to work and notices something strange. Why is it that he and Aoi are the only ones with cat ears?

Kaito is a college student who is a total womanizer. He brings home a different girl every night, annoying his next-door neighbor Asami and making him bang on the wall to shut Kaito and his guests up.
One day, Kaito hears Asami talking dirty on the phone...and it turns him on so much he ends up touching himself!
What's worse, Asami comes by to tell Kaito he knows what he was doing...

He is saved by Tomoru, who in response to Ritsu's request to pay him back, asks for his help in his after school job...as a professional girls' manga author. Ritsu agrees to act out scenes from Tomoru's manga, but when he learns he is meant to play the rival character instead of the hero, he grabs Tomoru by the collar and forces a kiss on him...

The two were days away from realizing their dream of playing together at the national high school tournament when Hiromu collides with Ryuji and injures himself during practice. Unable to play in the big game, Hiromu tries getting revenge by asking Ryuji, "Become my arm until I heal." To his surpise, Ryuji agrees......

God first created gadgets in his own image, and then used flesh to create human beings. Therefore, humans are destined to be slaves of the machines. Baguji, a cyborg, was born with emotions that a machine man should not have. He decides to go on a journey with Honoka, a girl who can help him control his emotions. To make friends with Honoka, to find her grandfather and creator Gennai, and to learn the meaning of his own existence...

(Source: Media Works, translated)

Cursed by the Queen of the Night simply for possessing a dazzling radiance, the little magical beast Ibara can only be freed by someone who truly loves him... Door-to-door couriers, who use delivery systems that don't depend on the old networks, are able to deliver "anything, anywhere". Keima Intercept Delivery, also known as "kid," is a small but well-known shipping company that receives a variety of requests. The company is run by three generations: Keima Yoku, a high school student who dreams of becoming a racer while helping out in the family business; his father, Sou, a former elite member of the Ministry of Distribution and a skilled hacker; and his grandfather, Ou, a legendary delivery driver. Don't miss this near-future human interest story about the activities of kid, a transportation company run by these three generations!

(Source: Goma Books, translated)

A princess trapped in a tower, guarded by a dragon, awaiting rescue by Prince Charming. Sound familiar? But what if the rescue doesn’t arrive in time? One of the mushrooms from the shiitake log the Takeda family purchased grows into an active, chatty little member of the family. This story is a heartwarming family comedy about the Takedas and the shiitake that lives in their garden.

134130.description: A manga by Kazuki Takahashi, done under the penname Kazuo Takahashi. It features Buray, an unreliable man who used his strong body to earn money by working as a hitman. Bonggang Choi has a secret. He lives a quiet life as an ordinary college student, but he was born with a special ability -- he can read minds. Preferring to keep to himself, he doesn't act on the things he learns while mind reading. But when he reads the mind of Hun Jo, another student at his school, and finds out that he may have killed someone, Bonggang soon discovers that he can’t close his eyes to evil forever.

134134.description:
Ryo Fukase, a young talent who is rapidly gaining popularity, loves cats despite his cool character. He sometimes disguises himself and secretly goes to cat cafes. One day, Ryo eats a candy given to him by a cat café worker and loses consciousness. When he wakes up, he finds himself naked in bed with the woman! The woman, who calls herself "Neko," threatens Ryo with naked photos of him and demands food and a place to live. At the height of his popularity, Ryo is in danger of a scandal! What is the purpose of the mysterious Neko?

134140.description:
Shun is timid and has a habit of giving up easily. That same Shun fell in love with his male classmate. So as not to let the people around him know about his sexuality, he lives his days trying to conceal it. However, the feelings he tried so hard to hide were exposed by the transfer student, Hiroki. At first, the my-paced and insensitive Hiroki did nothing but swing Shun around and confuse him, but he later finds himself gradually starting to be drawn to him.

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

134141.description:
Name’s Inori Takafuji. I’m not really much of a “go-getter,” if you catch my drift—sleep’s more my style—but getting summoned to another world kinda messed things up. Bit hard to chill when you’ve got a king in your face telling you there’s a bad guy you’ve gotta go slay or whatever, you know? Plot twist, though—it’s actually not so bad. Getting the hero treatment sounds pretty nice, right? But then it happens again! Some other clown summons me, I get my obligatory superpower, and off I go. And sure, that’s fine. It happens, sometimes you get isekai’d to the wrong place. But then it happens AGAIN! Someone ELSE summons me, I get ANOTHER superpower, and then I’m somewhere totally new. Repeat ad nauseam. No idea what’s going on, but all I want is one thing: stop !@#$ing summoning me!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Vowing to exact revenge if ever given the chance, Kaira is thrust back in time to right the wrongs committed against her and reclaim the title that is rightfully hers. 8. clockwork sugar night (clockwork sugar night) [Iwami Kiyoko]

title.native: レズ風俗アンソロジー プレミアム

134250.description:
Ryosuke, a junior high school student, lives alone with his sister-in-law, Nodoka, while his older brother is assigned elsewhere by work. Nodoka tries to take care of him in various ways, but she screws up so often that Ryosuke ends up having to follow her around. In addition, her screw-ups are so naughty that they are too stimulating for adolescent boys...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 兄ヨメさんの世話を焼く
title.romaji: Ani Yome-san no Sewa wo Yaku

134251.description:
Tohru has a superpower – he manages to be invisible without any magic at all! In fact, the only one who truly sees him is his childhood friend, Tsumugi, leading Tohru to have the crush to end all crushes on her. But when Tohru's "ability" leads him to accidentally discover a witch and strip her of her powers, he thinks he's screwed...until she offers to help him hook up with Tsumugi. But this witch's powers are revived only with a kiss? One thing's for sure—Tohru won't be invisible for long!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: The Witch Controls Her Age and Magic With a Kiss

title.romaji: Toshi to Mahou wa Kiss Shidai

134253.description: Tatsukawa Ryuu & Kotani Taiga are high school boys playing ping-pong and talking about their favorite girl, school cafeteria set meals, and whatever else interests them at the time.

134255.description:
Sada is an earnest high school teacher admired by students and colleagues alike. One night while walking through the city, he stumbles upon a student being violently attacked in an alley. As he tries to call for help, Sada finds himself on the end of the attacker's blade, bleeding to death on the ground. When he wakes up on a slab in an unknown laboratory, he comes face-to-face with his savior, a scientist named Mamiya. But Sada quickly realizes that in cheating death, he has become something...inhuman. What's more, he's now fully dependent on Mamiya to survive. What awaits him in this new life of death and deadly secrets?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

134256.description:
It all started because Miyo wanted to get to know Tetsu's new friend, Keita. Now, after five years together, Miyo, Keita, and Tetsu are Berry Canyon's Monkey Gang -that is, three talented climbers at the local bouldering gym "Berry Canyon." Suddenly, Keita announces he will be quitting bouldering, much to Miyo and Tetsu's surprise. Unable to contain her feelings, Miyo blurts out that she is aiming for the Olympics even though she rarely enters competitions, in the hopes that their gang can stay together. But now that she announced it, how will Miyo follow through? Will she be able to overcome her mental blocks and climb to the top? Or will the pressure get to her and make her lose her grip?

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.native: ストロベリー・キャニオン

134257.description:
Noriko is just getting started as a junior reporter for the Asagake Times. She wants to cover the hard-hitting issues, like world affairs and politics, but does she have the smarts for it? Thankfully, her overbearing and math-minded boss, Mr. Seki, is here to teach her how to analyze her stories with a mathematical eye.

In The Manga Guide to Calculus, you'll follow along with Noriko as she learns that calculus is more than just a class designed to weed out would-be science majors. You'll see that calculus is a useful way to understand the patterns in physics, economics, and the world around us, with help from real-world examples like probability, supply and demand curves, the economics of pollution, and the density of Shochu (a Japanese liquor).

Mr. Seki teaches Noriko how to:
Use differentiation to understand a function's rate of change
Apply the fundamental theorem of calculus, and grasp the relationship between a function's derivative and its integral
Integrate and differentiate trigonometric and other complicated functions
Use multivariate calculus and partial differentiation to deal with tricky functions
Use Taylor Expansions to accurately imitate difficult functions with polynomials

Whether you're struggling through a calculus course for the first time or you just need a painless refresher, you'll find what you're looking for in The Manga Guide to Calculus.

(Source: No Starch Press)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Differentiation and Integral Calculus

title.native: マンガでわかる微分積分

134258.description:
Newbie director Urs Kaufmann is busy working on the script to a C-class porno requested by the Mafia, alongside his co-author Dieter Brenner. All seems well until one day, the Mafia boss they've been working for summons Urs to let him know that Dieter ran off with the film budget - a whopping 30,000 euros! Urs rushes off to find where Dieter went, but the Mafia has other plans, sending off their seasoned hitman, Leo!

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.native: ヴィエンナ・コネクション

134259.description:
The manga uses familiar concrete examples of Fourier analysis of images to make the subject understandable.
Through the story of a band of three high school girls, the manga covers the mathematical foundations of Fourier analysis, including differential, integral, and trigonometric functions, in a way that's easy to read.
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Fourier Analysis
世界第一簡單傅立葉分析

title.native: マンガでわかるフーリエ解析

134260.description:
Hayasaka, a competent yet people-pleasing salesman, decides to let Kumagai, a part-time local convenience store worker, live with him in order to protect a cat he rescued. Although reluctant at first, Hayasaka gradually begins to feel comfortable having Kumagai stay with him and opens up about vulnerabilities he's never shown others. One day, Kumagai, with a sweet look on his face, tells Hayasaka how cute he is which makes Hayasaka catch feelings...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 契約コハビテーション

134261.description:
The former chef of Hakodate's Goryokakutei, Kitagata Toshizou! The man who has been contracted to completely turn around a restaurant on the verge of failing! When it comes to cooking techniques, ideas, and spirit he is unrivaled! Only those that can make it through Toshizou's earth shattering training will be able to gain footing on the road to revival. Then comes in another shop...!!

(Source: Media Do International/Nihonbungeisha)

134262.description:
Istina was just an ordinary high school girl until she got struck by lightning. Upon opening her eyes, she realizes that she has woken up inside her favorite novel. At first, she's ecstatic that she'll get to meet her favorite character, Laon, but her excitement quickly dies down when she gets a look at her reflection in a mirror. The beautiful little girl looking back at her, with red hair and purple eyes, is the bully who torments Laon relentlessly and makes his childhood a living hell. But mending her relationship with Laon isn't the only thing Istina has to worry about. Laon is fated to die while protecting the female lead, but Istina isn't about to let that happen, even if it means that she'll have to get her hands dirty. Will Istina be able to tame the prickly swordmaster and change his ending at the same time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

134263.description:
Megumi is an all-star athlete, but she's a failure when it comes to physics class. And she can't concentrate on her tennis matches when she's worried about the questions she missed on the big test! Luckily for her, she befriends Ryota, a patient physics geek who uses real-world examples to help her understand classical mechanics-and improve her tennis game in the process!

In The Manga Guide to Physics, you'll follow alongside Megumi as she learns about the physics of everyday objects like roller skates, slingshots, braking cars, and tennis serves. In no time, you'll master tough concepts like momentum and impulse, parabolic motion, and the relationship between force, mass, and acceleration.

You'll also learn how to:
Apply Newton's three laws of motion to real-life problems
Determine how objects will move after a collision
Draw vector diagrams and simplify complex problems using trigonometry
Calculate how an object's kinetic energy changes as its potential energy increases

If you're mystified by the basics of physics or you just need a refresher, The Manga Guide to Physics will get you up to speed in a lively, quirky, and practical way.

(Source: No Starch Press)
synonyms: Le guide manga de la mécanique (du point)

title.native: マンガでわかる物理　力学編

134264.description:
Join Kanna, Kanta, Yamane, and Gloria in The Manga Guide to the Universe as they explore our solar system, the Milky Way, and faraway galaxies in search of the universe’s greatest mysteries: dark matter, cosmic expansion, and the Big Bang itself.

As you rocket across the night sky, you’ll become acquainted with modern astronomy and astrophysics, as well as the classical discoveries and theories on which they’re built. You’ll even learn why some scientists believe finding extraterrestrial life is inevitable!

You’ll also learn about:
Discoveries made by Copernicus, Galileo, Kepler, Hubble, and other seminal astronomers
Theories of the universe’s origins, evolution, and geometry
The ways you can measure and observe heavenly bodies with different telescopes, and how astronomers calculate distances in space
Stellar classifications and how the temperature, size, and magnitude of a star are related
Cosmic background radiation, what the WMAP satellite discovered, and scientists’ predictions for the future of the universe

So dust off your flight suit and take a fantastic voyage through the cosmos in The Manga Guide to the Universe.

(Source: No Starch Press)

title.english: The Manga Guide to the Universe

134265.description:
The Manga Guide to Electronic Circuits teaches electronics in a refreshingly simple way using authentic Japanese comics. As readers follow along with the story, they learn electrical fundamentals like Kirchoff's laws, voltage and current amplification, impedance matching, and how to analyze the most complex circuit and signal diagrams. Along the way, they're immersed in the components that make up complex electronic circuits, like amplifiers, oscillators, and modulators, as well as how these circuits use semiconductor devices like diodes and transistors. Ultimately, readers discover how electronic circuits are used to create integrated circuits and computers.

(Source: Amazon.com)

title.native: マンガでわかる電子回路

134266.description:
A high school student Aisaka Itsumo, who loves taking apart electronic devices, tries to get a job at an appliance thrift store. The book introduces the reader to the features and types of digital circuits, the reasons for their widespread use, basic logic design techniques, and the ideas behind them.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Digital Circuits

title.native: マンガでわかるディジタル回路

134267.description:
Akane, Shiraishi, and Eki go to the same school and additionally participate in the physics club. Akane is the oldest, she is the head of the club, Shiraishi is the smartest, and Eki is the most unpredictable and believes in the occult. One day Eki had a prophetic dream in which a plane crashed and a ship sank. And then she wondered why planes fly and ships don't sink at all. It turns out that the science that can answer these and other questions is called hydrodynamics (or fluid mechanics), and Eki with Akane asked Shiraishi to tell them about it.

Together with our characters, we will take a fascinating journey into the world of fluids and learn many new and interesting things about their properties and laws which they obey and which we use in everyday life without even realizing it.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Fluid Mechanics
世界第一簡單流體力學

title.native: マンガでわかる流体力学

134268.description:
Kiyohara Kazuma, a city employee, is assigned a task that cannot be accomplished without machine learning. Under the guidance of his longtime acquaintance Miyano Sayaka, he learns about artificial intelligence, from the very basics to deep learning.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Machine Learning

title.native: マンガでわかる機械学習

134269.description: Hundred years ago, a generation of God of War Ye Qingyun was born, crushing the sons of various great figures, making the enemy frightened by the wind, but unexpectedly betrayed by his lover Luo Ling, brother wolf thirteen, and falling into the Devil Abyss! A hundred years later, all walks of life entered the golden age, and wicked characters emerged wildly! Ye Qingyun was reborn as a waste disciple of the Ye Family, a small family in the Eight Desolate Continent! Fate is reversed and fate is changed! In this life, I will not only crush the genius, but also kill all those who bear me! A ruthless sword, a dragon slaying knife, kill everything, unify the gods, dominate all things!
synonyms: God of War Against the Sky

134270.description: A veteran of the Burma Campaign who suffers from daydreams bumps into a young woman and talks to her at a café.

134271.description: A manga artist joins a large group which discusses plans to get revenge on the government.

title.english: A Tale of Absolute and Utter Nonsense

134272.description: A group of men wait outside a blood bank exchanging stories while waiting to sell their blood so they can eat for the day.

134273.description:
This comic depicts a kind of piecemeal post-war commune, one that hosts drifters, con men, and other lost souls. Its inhabitants live in makeshift huts on a grassy plain that was once a military site, bombed and destroyed by US pilots.

(Source: The Comics Journal)

134275.description:
A couple of characters from a parallel world, Fuse and Cosmo, gradually raise their level by challenging them with problems on various electrical circuits, from direct and alternating current to electricity generation and transmission.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Electric Circuit

title.native: マンガでわかる電気回路

134276.description:
This manga is about the wonderful building material concrete and installations made of it. The Romans were the first to use concrete to build roads, bridges, harbors, temples, squares, and water systems, many of which still survive today. Together with the Kenji, an architecture student, and the Sibyl, you'll find out how Roman concrete was different from modern concrete, walk across the Hijiri-Bashi Bridge, and visit the Hukagawa Cement Factory.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)

title.native: マンガでわかるコンクリート

134277.description:
Xinwen was just a history major student until she’s caught in a fire at the library. Before she passes out, she sees a vision of a woman and then wakes up in a different world. Now she must live as Princess Wenxin Li, the only imperial magic user of the Flower Nation, sent to The United Realms for a political marriage. Treated as an outsider and challenged to use magic that she doesn’t know, she must fend off rivals seeking to bring about her downfall… while also figuring out why the former queen speaks to her in her dreams.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Princess From The Far East
転生したら魔法持ちの王妃でした～元学生の私がイケメン公爵の婚約者に!?～

134278.description:
The dainty idol Chen Congong unluckily fell into a trap and awoke to a stunning naked man in her bed! Hahaha, I don't mind ending up with such a beautiful man?

Hang on...

Are you telling me I've switched places with the toxic, evil, and manipulative side character who won’t even survive 20% of the plot?! No, I'm definitely not ready to die!! Watch as I keep on living my ideal life!

(Source: QQ, translated)

title.native: 我成了反派大佬的小娇妻？！
title.romaji: Wo Cheng Le Fan Pai Da Lao De Xiao Jiao Qi?!

134279.description:
This volume contains 3 stories:

1. K's confession (Ｋの告白) originally published in Hana to Yume magazine 1993 volumes 4-6 (1993-01-20 to 1993-02-20)
2. The maze I saw at dawn (夜明けに見た迷路)
3. Tian-Noyu (ティアーン＝ノユ)

134280.description:
A story of two men sharing stories of Sabu, a local tough guy and kamikaze trainee who survived the war. The conversation leads to the older man remarking that, “After the war was over... We were all still hurting. None of our wounds had healed yet.”

(Source: The Comics Journal)

134281.description:
A collection of stories by Tadao Tsuge. Includes seven of his most famous works such as Burai Heiya, Burai no Machi, Yotarou Inu, and Tabi no Owari ni.

"In the past, I have occasionally drawn comics in which the protagonist is a ruffian, a yob, a thug, etc., either on a spur of the moment or on impulse. Perhaps it was my only escape from a somewhat unstable life situation, and a field where I could indulge in debauchery and indulgence." - Tadao Tsuge

(Source: Waizu Shuppan)

134282.description: Ordinary elementary school student Ji-soo, a boy far removed from the world of mathematics, is revealed to be the knight of X who can prevent the resurrection of the infinite Demon King and the destruction of the mathematics world. He leaves for Atlantis, where he exponentially grows in power and learns mathematics.

title.native: 無気力無口系JK日々谷さん うっかり先生のカキタレになっちゃいました。
title.romaji: Mukiryoku Mukuchikei JK Hibiya-san: Ukkari Sensei no Kakitare ni Nacchaimashita.

134285.description: Published on the magazine Comic Grape Vol. 77 (2020-03).

title.native: ピュアエロ金髪ギャル 〜俺の教え子の巨乳がエロ過ぎて誘惑に勝てるわけがない〜
title.romaji: Pure Ero Kinpatsu Gal: Ore no Oshiego no Kyonyuu ga Erosugite Yuuwaku ni Kateru Wake ga Nai

134287.description:
Next Crows Supplementary Story is a side series for Crows.

The first half of the manga tells the story of the feud between TFOA's Fourth Generation and Kyouya's new leader, while the second half of the manga tells the story of Kizu Kyousuke, a long-time friend of Parko, Kiiko, Teru and Kouhei.

Chapter names:
First part:Shidaime Busou Sensenhen (四代目武装戦線編)
Second part:Kizu Kyousukehen (木津京介編)

title.native: ソロ神官のVRMMO冒険記 ～どこから見ても狂戦士です本当にありがとうございました～
title.romaji: Solo Shinkan no VRMMO Boukenki: Doko kara Mite mo Berserker desu Hontou ni Arigatou Gozaimashita

134292.description:
Ryuu Shinjou is a student who is invited (forced) by his best friend to enter the world of virtual and online role-playing games (VRMMORPG).

During the game and when choosing his class, Ryuu decides to become a "priest," through which he can regain his health through magic and thus play alone. However, his playing style is far from what you would call a "normal priest." It is time to learn the story from Ryuu, the priest who instills terror into anyone who dares to stand in his way.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title.native: ソロ神官のVRMMO冒険記 ～どこから見ても狂戦士です本当にありがとうございました～
title.romaji: Solo Shinkan no VRMMO Boukenki: Doko kara Mite mo Berserker desu Hontou ni Arigatou Gozaimashita

134293.description: This work contains two newly drawn works "Yasakura Shura," "Narigo" and both remake and original 1969 Garo version of "Natsukashi no Melody."

134298.description: The story of an average businessman with subtle hints of his time in the military and WW2.

134299.description:
The story follows “Wandering Wolf”, it puts two men under the same awning as they wait for a storm to pass. They meet as strangers, only for the younger of the pair—a criminal on the run—to realize that the other one is “Kamikaze Sabu,” a brawler he admired in his youth.

(Source: The Comics Journal)

Note: the first chapter was published in the June 1976 issue of Yagyo. The second chapter was published in the September 1976 issue of Garo.

134301.description: The story of a gangster in search of a woman named Shadow. He meets a mysterious and anthropomorphic mutt along the way who turns out to be more than meets the eye.

134302.description:
A story taking place in the harem of the Osmann Empire in the 17th century on the story of friendship and desire of two girls, Nascha and Asha.

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

134303.description: Midori, Momoko, and Shiho are friends in high school. Momoko is in the art club, Shiho is in the swimming club, and Midori has a hobby of searching out bizarre things. One day, Midori finds a new cafe for them to go to—a weird 'space' cafe with an owner who wears an astronaut helmet! The three of them pass their days together, encountering plenty of strange situations along the way.

title.native: 脇役女子は後輩くんに酔わされたい
title.romaji: Wakiyaku Joshi wa Kouhai-kun ni Yowasaretai

134306.description: A woman visits a hitman for him to kill her.

134307.description: Ran Koda, who works as a teacher in a ceramic art class, hides the secret of suffering from "androphobia." This becomes an issue when good looking men start joining the class.

title.native: それでも男は信じません

134308.description: Hayama can't handle looking directly into people's eyes. This leads to a misunderstanding with one of her classmates, Yoshida.
synonyms: The Reason Why I Can't Look at His Eyes Directly

title.native: 目を合わせられない理由

134309.description:
Ji Wanqing, an A-lister in the showbiz who doesn't care about family, love or fame but money, finds herself stuck in a dilemma after meeting Sheng Yu, an attractive popular singer. Will Wanqing, a self-proclaimed aromantic, fall for the flirty and sweet Sheng Yu? Ji Wanqing, an A-lister in the showbiz who doesn't care about family, love or fame but money, finds herself stuck in a dilemma after meeting Sheng Yu, an attractive popular singer. Will Wanqing, a self-proclaimed aromantic, fall for the flirty and sweet Sheng Yu?

(Source: WebComics)

134311.description:
The story picks up the events of Tekken 2 with Jun Kazama and Kazuya Mishima as the main characters. The plot is not canon.

(Source: Fandom wiki)

134312.description:
Our bodies are equipped with "immunity," a mechanism that protects us from infection and disease. This book covers the basic mechanism of immune response, as well as infectious diseases, autoimmune diseases, allergies, and transplantation medicine, which is of current interest. The book introduces the difficult-to-understand mechanisms of immunity in an easy-to-understand manner using cartoons and text explanations, making it a worthwhile introductory text.

(Source: Ohmsha, translated)

title.native: マンガでわかる免疫学

134313.description:
This manga provides an easy-to-understand explanation of soil mechanics and geotechnical engineering, where students learn theories for civil engineering design, through cartoons. Our lives are based on the ground. If the ground is not thoroughly investigated and appropriate measures are not taken, problems such as ground subsidence and liquefaction may occur after several decades or even centuries. In other words, geotechnical engineering is such an important and fundamental study that civil engineering, architecture, and social life would not be possible without it.
The setting of the manga is a university club called the "Soil Study Group. The members of the club ask questions such as, "What is soil? "What are its properties? "Why does liquefaction occur? and so on, and through fieldwork, they come face to face with these mysteries.

(Source: Ohmsha, translated)
synonyms: The Manga Guide to Soil Mechanics

title.native: マンガでわかる土質力学

134314.description:
The four main characters Aya, Rina, Saki, and Yuka invite you into the world of human relationships. You will learn what socially correct behavior is and how best to behave so as not to make others inconvenience you. This subject is studied as a separate major in universities, but at the same time sociology is an applied science necessary for all people living in the modern world. Standards of behavior and attitudes vary from country to country, but there are some common ones. You will also learn about the Japanese New Year's custom of otoshidama and why the Japanese throw a 5 yen coin into the temple, learn to control your emotions and distinguish between rational, irrational and affective actions. But human is not a machine, and their actions cannot be so easily categorized.

(Source: DMK Press, translated)

title.native: マンガでわかる社会学

134315.description:
At the height of the Ming Dynasty, Beijing seemed like a prosperous city by day. But in the darkness of the night, creatures of ancient myth like demons, fairies, ghosts and monsters appear, mixed amongst mortals. The reappearance of the Potion of Immortality has drawn out the gods, demons and even the royal guards... And the young girl Min Ruyue, carrying the secret of the potion, is caught in the fight for the potion between heaven and earth. Is the sudden appearance of a companion beside her a friend or foe? Will she be able to control her own destiny?

(Source: Manman Comics, translated)

134316.description:
Five thousand years ago, a young man worked tirelessly for cultivation, but because of his special physique, was unable to break through the physical training period and enter the next realm of cultivation. He has been practicing from the ancient era to the modern day. Now living in the big city, Xuan Yuanming sits at body refining level ninety-nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine. He set a small goal for himself: first to cultivate his body to level 100,000!

(Source: QQ, translated)
synonyms: 100,000 Levels of Body Refining: All the Dogs I Raise Are the Emperor
One Hundred Thousand Layers of Body Refining: All the Dogs I Raise Are the Emperor

title.native: 炼体十万层：我养的狗都是大帝
title.romaji: Lian Ti Shiwan Ceng: Wo Yang De Gou Dou Shi Da Di

134317.description: October 15, 2002. Toru Hasuike waited anxiously and nervously at the airport for his younger brother Kaoru, who was abducted by North Korean agents on July 31, 1978. However, being imprisoned and under strict monitoring in North Korea for 24 years, Kaoru is no longer the same person and has become a liaison for North Korean government. Toru then determined to use every manner he could think of to persuade Kaoru to stay in Japan.
synonyms: 奪還―北朝鮮拉致ドキュメンタリー

134318.description:
Falling all the way to the bottom... wandering father and son survive at the bottom!

Hot-headed teacher Susumu Hinomoto (Papa) sets off on an endless journey with his son Koji in search of his wife Masako, who has disappeared, leaving behind debts she incurred playing pachinko. Dad's misfortunes on the road leave him short of funds. Is his solution debt or...?

A heartwarming and shocking story about the irredeemable stupidity of everyone!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

134320.description:
"Sunbae, what have you been up to these last few nights?"

Taeyoung, who is living with his hobae(his buddy), Junghoon, has a problem. He relieves himself while thinking of Junghoon every night, but can't finish. But what is..?! While they're drinking together, Junghoon offers to lend his hand...!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

134321.description:
Is blacking out always this scary? Imagine blacking out and waking up in a different world! A teacher finds herself in the body of lady Lucia, a woman who committed suicide. While trying to understand what happened, she realizes Lucia was actually murdered. Why does the emperor hide behind a mask? And what really happened to Lucia...?

(Source: Copin Comics)

134322.description:
What happens when a girl who wants to date but doesn't believe in love meets a guy who likes to flirt but thinks relationships are a drag? That's how it is for Na-Bi and Jae-Eon, two art students who meet in college and develop a strong connection -- inspired by butterflies. As they get to know each other and their relationship progresses, they'll face the early stages of attraction and the ups and downs of dating. This story will make you long to be in a relationship -- even when you know it won't be easy.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

134323.description:
Lamia, harpy, scylla ... A large collection of H masterpieces about being loved by various monster girls!

This volume includes the following chapters:

#Cover Illustration: Xe
1. Kemonokko Tsushin -Koumori Musume Vivi- (けものっ娘通信～蝙蝠娘ビビ～) [Jun]
2. Elma to Maboroshi no Hana (エルマと幻の花) [Konshin]
3. App Dentai Happy Harpy (アプリでへんたいハッピーハーピー) [Horitomo]
4. Tsuresari Dragon (連れ去りドラゴン) [Harigane Shinshi]
5. Fuwa Toro Fragance -Mori no Mamono wa Amai Yume- (ふわとろフレグランス ～森のマモノは甘い夢～)[Amamiya Shinjitsu]
6. Mon ☆ Cafe Yori Ai wo Komete (モン☆カフェより愛を込めて♥) [Kuroshiki]
7. Squid Love! (スクイッド・ラヴ!) [Z-Ton]
8. Love s"T"ickness girl (Love s“T”ickness girl) [Nakamura Regura]
9. Kurage no Onee-san (海月のお姉さん) [Ahobaka]
10. Level 1 (レベル1) [Amamitu Kousuke]
11. Kaiki Nantai Katatsumuri Musume (怪奇軟体蝸牛娘) [Memarei]
synonyms: Comic Unreal The Best Mon Musume Love H Collection

134342.description:
Dragon Boy is a manga by Akira Toriyama that ran originally in the Fresh Jump. It was later released in Akira Toriyama's Manga Theater Vol. 2. Dragon Boy is best known for being a prototype for the much more popular Dragon Ball manga, which began the following year.

Dragon Boy features the adventures of a boy named Tangtong and an unlikely ragtag group who go on a journey to the Flower Country. This short work is 45-page long (15 for the first chapter and 21 for the second), and it combines the comedic style of Toriyama's successful Dr. Slump series with a more action-oriented plot and pays homage to famous martial art actor Jackie Chan. Toriyama noted that his goal for the series was to tell an "unconventional and contradictory" story. Like Dragon Ball, this manga is mainly based on the Chinese story Journey to the West. Several elements from the story were later reused in Dragon Ball, largely in the first 13 chapters, notably the martial arts theme and the general atmosphere. Dragon Boy even has its own version of the Dragon Ball artifacts. However, in this incarnation, the Dragon Balls produce small dragons when hit with an energy blast, which actually was quite useless when Tangtong summoned it in the story.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134344.description:
The Adventures of Tongpoo is a one-shot manga by Akira Toriyama that was published in the 1983 52nd issue of Weekly Shōnen Jump and was later released in the compilation Akira Toriyama's Manga Theater Vol. 2.

Along with Dragon Boy, The Adventures of Tongpoo served as an inspiration for Dragon Ball. It is forty-five pages long, and it introduced an early concept of the Capsule as well as story elements for the second Dragon Ball chapter, "No Balls!"

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Chihiro may not have a place to call home currently and Keito may not be a good person by any means, but maybe the two of them could be happy together.

134347.description: When the company Sakita had been working at went out of business, he returned to his small-city hometown for a second start as the head of a call-girl business, "Fruits Delivery Service." This drama tells the tale of a group of women who, being poor and faced with a variety of life situations, have no choice but to work as call girls. It is a work that calls into question how to deal with the inequalities of society.

134348.description:
Kennosuke is a 5–6 years-old samurai very well mannered and very serious. He has a date with a girl named Miss Oden. Not knowing the good practice in a date, Kennosuke seeks advice from his mother and his best friend Shinobimaru, with discretion, so that no one realizes it is his first time. After a visit to the seaside and time passed in a small cafe, Kennosuke gets the opportunity to demonstrate his ability in combat when a gang tries to steal his money.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134349.description:
Tetsunoshin Kataiwa is a cool old man who is the mayor of Pon Pon village, a small village in the countryside by the sea. He protects his village using his Suzuki Jimny, a vehicle he nicknamed "Pochi". One day, he tracks a man because he passed through the village and threw a juice can out his car. Unknown to Tetsunoshin, the man is actually a dangerous gangster who will try to destroy the largest power plant in the country with the help of his accomplice, in an attempt destroy the whole land. Thanks to his car which has the ability to fly and fire rockets, the mayor stops the criminal and saves the land.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134350.description:
Mamejiro is a 6-years-old boy who lives in the countryside. He is very strong and courageous, due to helping his parents in agricultural work. After his father, a former professional wrestler, ate his ice cream, Mamejiro decides to become a delinquent. For his first felony, with the help of his best friend Joji, he decides to steal the money of a man who happens to be the burglar who attacked the neighboring agricultural cooperative. For helping the police intercept the man, Mamejiro is rewarded with a mountain of ice cream.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134351.description:
In year 9 of the Hanpeï era, Karamaru-kun, a four-year-old ninja, has to bring mushrooms in town and sell them to buy medicins and cigarettes for his sick grandfather. On the way, he meets a car stealer who thinks he is ninja as well. The car stealer helps Karamaru to stop a gang of three ninja thieves who took his mushrooms (they do not steal the car because none of them has a driving license). In the end, convinced that he must be a good example to the young boy, the car stealer brings the car to the police and offers Karamaru to become his disciple.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134352.description:

He repairs his ship but, short of fuel, he has to take the appearance of the man he accidentally killed when he arrived on Earth, Chapat, a lazy and coward policeman from Slope Town. To raise the sum of 17 million yen needed to buy fuel for his ship, which is gold, Jiora fights crime for money as Cashman, resuming his extraterrestrial appearance.

(Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

134353.description:
After Koganei was rejected by a girl he had confessed to, he angrily ran off and was hit by a car.

When he woke up, he found that he was reincarnated in another world as Theodore Goldberg, the eldest son of a marquis. And of course, as Koganei is no stranger to isekai series, he knows that he will have some sort of cheat skill to become overpowered and live a slow life.

And so he tries to open up his status screen... only to find that this world doesn’t have video game stats. He then tries to use his OP magic skills... only to find out he is too young to even learn magic. So then he tries swordsmanship... but turns out to be weak with the blade. And so he decides to just invent modern technology to get ahead... only to find out that this world has magical devices which are identical to modern technology.

Theodore is at an impasse. He’s not strong, he’s not smart, and he’s not handsome. So what exactly is his cheat skill? For what purpose was he reincarnated in the first place if he was just reborn as an ordinary boy?

This short manga (originally 50 pages long) was written after My Wandering Warrior Existence and was only released on digital platforms in Japan. Seven Seas initially published the manga in English as an ebook exclusive before the release of the book written after it – My Pancreas Broke, But My Life Got Better– in order to preserve the chronological timeline of new entries in Nagata Kabi’s powerful autobiographical series. Now, the anticipated release of the printed edition is here!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Nonetheless, Nicola's older sister, Satella, has other plans for him, appointing Nicola as the teacher of the class composed of the weakest alumni in the Shanoa Academy. There, he meets Alice, a tender and lovely elf girl. In a world where a person's worth is determined by their muscles, Alice ranks among the lowest, and to change herself, she enlists Nicola's aid to learn from him a fighting style in which... anything goes! This is a battle fantasy story of rising to the top through clever but underhanded tactics!

They cursed his cowardly fighting methods as a disgrace and Nicolas left with burning hatred for the comrades who betrayed him, vowing never to work again…Until six months after his banishment, Nicolas, whose motto is to fight with cowardly methods, passed the exam without difficulty and became the homeroom teacher for a class full of failures. There he found Alice, the princess of the elven domain.

In a world where a person's value is determined by their muscles, Alice's thin figure is treated as "ugly" and she is scorned as weak. Alice wants become strong to protect her country as a princess.

"If I can protect my friends, I don't mind being ridiculed. Please make me your apprentice."

In the meantime, the hero's party has fallen on hard times and his former friends are looking for Nicolas…

It is there that he meets Hajime Ogata, a doctor of disconcerting beauty... Fascinated, Take is determined to learn more about the enigmatic Ogata... but uncovering the secrets of his heart is another matter entirely.

One day, she suddenly lost her house and her job due to suspicions of an affair. She was in desperate straits, and the person who reached out to help her was a friend from high school, Hoshizora, whom she hadn't seen in a long time...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

134385.description:
Innocent man framed for murder and sentenced to death. Released 17 years later after his name was cleared. The times have changed. Yeop has changed. His friends and family have changed. Nothing is the same anymore. The harsh reality surrounding him turned Yeop from a grateful young man to a stoic, skeptical person. And now, he wants to exact revenge on everything that worked together to ruin his life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The young president of the Dibicci bank, Lawrence Dibicci, controls the economic world of the Cosimo Empire. One day, a girl named Rahui is thrown under his wings instead of her father's debt.

(Source: Copin Comics)

134388.description:
Min-Jun has a very peculiar condition: he’s hypersensitive to the point where he gets turned on by women constantly. Even the mere sound of a woman breathing next to him can get him worked up. So he’s built a life avoiding women, even to the point of picking a job on a team where there’s only men. Except, that carefully built life is at risk when Su-Min is assigned to his team. Now, Min-Jun must navigate his way through the office with a gorgeous coworker making his life harder and harder. Will Min-Jun be able to keep everything under wraps and in his pants? Or will he finally let it all out?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

134389.description:
Seconds after winning his case, Se-Hyuk is immediately called to investigate another murder - this time, with a suspect who claims to be his biggest fan. I-Deun, the suspect in question who holds the key to the investigation, requests a "private" sitting with Se-Hyuk, in all essence of the word. As the mystery unveils, unpleasant truths and painful memories rise to the surface once again, plunging Se-Hyuk deeper into madness.

After going over to complain about a noise that kept going off in the middle of the night, the two end up becoming close as Jae approaches him amiably. However, Sunhwa claims he cannot forget Sun, comes to his doorstep, and Sun hears the most unexpected words from Jae but…

Even though he sometimes has trouble balancing child-rearing and work, Kiichi still managed to build a family-like relationship. But there is one thing that he's been hiding and that is his years-long unrequited love for Ryuu. To make sure that Mako has a happy childhood, Kiichi had planned to keep his feelings hidden forever but one drunken night, he ended up sleeping with Ryuu?! This a heartrending story about a painful unrequited love and family bonds.

“Onii-san, congratulations on your marriage. This person is your bride.” “M-my name is Watanae Yuuka… I’m in the same class as you…”

My name is Sakata Yuuichi. I’m in my 2nd year of high school. Due to my parents’ circumstances, I’m suddenly getting married..? Furthermore, my partner is a plain girl, Watanae-san.

During my 3rd year of middle school, I went through a bad experience. Ever since then, I’ve only been interested in 2D heroines. There’s absolutely no way I’d ever be interested in a 3D girl. That was what I thought, but…

“…Well then, who’s your favorite heroine right now?”

Turns out, she was actually an otaku and she becomes very talkative when you get to know her. She’d always happily engage in our conversations. She showed me things I’d never have expected from a girl in my class.

“Err, since we’re going to be living together… Is it okay if I call you Yuu-kun?”

And, the moment I let my guard down, she’d instantly try to shorten the distance between us. What’s more…

“Just between you and me, I’m actually the voice actress for Yuuna Izumi from 『Alice Stage』. Thank you for always supporting me!”

It’s a secret from everyone else, but it turns out she’s actually my favorite heroine’s voice actress?!

I am only interested in 2D heroines! But, Yuuka’s true self, which she only shows when she’s alone with me, is nothing but cute!

This is the story of me and Yuuka, starting as fiancees. A heartwarming and chaotic romcom!

Twenty-year-old former wage slave Yuki Tanaka now works among her idols: the streamers of Live-On, one of Japan’s top VTuber companies. As the gorgeous, polite Awayuki Kokorone, she delivers only the most ladylike content. Unfortunately, her subscriber count and savings are at rock bottom. One evening, after Yuki thinks she’s ended her stream, she cracks a few cold ones—and more than a few crude jokes—while watching Live-On’s video archives. But her viewers hear it all, and clips of her bawdy, drunken commentary go viral overnight. Yuki thinks her career is over...until her manager reveals that everyone at Live-On has been waiting for her to snap all along and gives her free rein to drink on-stream. Now free of all feigned purity, she jumps right into her new “rowdy drunk” character and is welcomed into the fold by her fellow Live-On VTubers, who turn out to be just as crazy as she is! With her views and finances skyrocketing, Yuki’s work—for the first time in her life—is actually fun!

What fatal connection do all these chaotic happenings have with the Underworld? Yama is Eastern death gods who are in charge of life and death (especially in China and Japan) in the underworld—the place where all dead souls congregate. It was once ruled by ten Yamas, each with their own responsibilities. Yet the Fifth Yama, tired of slaving away at the office desk, decides to leave the Underworld and travel to the Mortal World with Bai Wuchang, one of the Underworld employees, in tow. Rumor has it that they're searching for the Sixth Yama, who headed up to the Mortal World a thousand years ago and never returned. An autobiographical manga based on Yoshiharu Tsuge's adolescence. Set in a downtown plating factory, the work follows Mr. Wolves, the owner of the factory, and a young worker named Yoshio, alongside other employees.

Note: Published in Bessatsu Manga Story (April 1973). Republished in Monthly Manga Garo No. 131 (July 1974).

134578.description:
"It is said that salamanders have no memory of the past because of the polluted water." This work follows a salamander waking up in a sewer with no recollection of the past, but out of place, as if they were reborn as a completely different creature. The salamander grows accustomed to their new habitat until one day when an incomprehensible object appears in the sewer.

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 33 (May 1967).

134579.description:
When Yanagida found out that his student is homosexual, he fell in love with him.
He had to run away from everything and became a vagabond.

(Source: Fusion Project, translated)

134580.description:
Meguro Oto is an animator working in a rural animation studio.

After breaking up with her fiancé just before she turned 30, she decided to start afresh by leaving Tokyo and taking up the offer she received from Taga to work at his studio in the countryside.

She is currently satisfied with her pseudo-relationship with Taga, who she both loves and respects, but her current life just doesn't seem to sit well with her and she spends her days wishing to have an anime-like reincarnation into another world.

One day, the handsome voice actor, Haruto, who voices Lloyd, Oto's most favourite anime character, visits the studio. And somehow, the usually cool Haruto keeps on approaching her...

134581.description:
A famous actor named Gu Kai randomly traveled into a parallel universe in the past that is known as the Country of the RoseFinch. In order to save his own life, he became the empress and began his journey in this parallel universe which often involved: eating and sleeping, fighting evil officials, and protecting his virginity from the Emperor.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Don't Touch Me You Gay Emperor!

134582.description:
Touko's husband's lover is about to start living together with her family and her. Add a handsome and mysterious young man who has feelings for Touko into this mix and we have the start of an unusual living arrangement together.

What is the shocking reason behind Touko's decision for this strange cohabitation?

134583.description:
A surreal, avant-garde two-colour printed manga work based on Yoshiharu Tsuge's experience traveling to Futomi in Chiba prefecture. It is especially famous among the works of Tsuge and had a great influence not only on the Japanese manga world but also on many other fields.

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 47 (Tsuge Yoshiharu Tokushuu, 10th June 1968).

134584.description:
Hikaru is working to help her friend from their college days, Kikuta, with his gameplay video streaming. One of her jobs is to protect Kikuta from his more obsessive followers. But she herself has no romantic feelings for him, and in fact she hasn't had any romantic relationships in a while. Until Hikaru becomes obsessed with a streamer who posts drawing videos… Caught between overlapping worlds — reality/fantasy, physical/virtual, truth/fiction — she must find "true love" for herself.

(Source: Kodansha, translated).

134585.description:
Sumida Uta was supposed to start a new phase of her life with her husband, Kimi-kun, in their newly built house... but Kimi-kun passed away from an accident soon after.

Those around her have been trying to help her move on by telling her that she's still young and that she should start moving forward with her new life. But right now, she just can't seem to imagine that happening.

And that's because Kimi-kun is still in their house with her!

She has lost her dearest husband but after remembering her dream of opening a restaurant, she begins to work on her new life with the help of her (ghost) husband!

134588.description:
It's been two years since Saki Miyamoto moved to Tokyo. She is so occupied with work that she doesn't even know how to make friends, let alone find a boyfriend. Then, she runs into her childhood friend Ke-chan for the first time in more than 10 years, and is invited to join him in a shared house in a high-rise apartment. Saki decides to join, hoping to meet some new people. However, the other residents there besides Ke-chan are both Ke-chan's lovers...? Saki and company living together in a titillating story about a new form of love under one roof!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.romaji: Kei-chan no Koibito wa Futari Iru

134590.description:
In the small town in Hokkaido where she was born and raised, Mifuyu falls in love with a man who has been transferred to Tokyo for work. Just as she follows her love to Tokyo, she witnesses an unexpected sight!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

134604.description:
A dream-like manga where a man prods a pin-up girl in an erotic magazine with tweezers, pulls her out of the magazine and eats her to test her beauty. He's then paranoid of people finding out and being incarcerated so he goes on to destroy all of the evidence.

Note: Published in Custom Comic No. 3 (September 1979).

134607.description:
This tale is set at a small hot springs inn where a samurai is relaxing when he is asked to share his room. His new roommate appears to be none other than Musashi Miyamoto.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 12 (August 1965).

134608.description:
A simple rural encounter is charged with sexual tension that is alluring but also fraught with danger. When a young woman happens upon a wing-shot goose, she tries to calm it then suddenly snaps its neck. Later, she befriends a young hunter and offers him shelter, but her motivations remain unclear, especially when the hunter notices a snake in the room where they’ll both be sleeping.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 18 (February 1966).

134609.description:
A simple domestic drama about expectations, fidelity, and escape. A couple purchase a beautiful white bird with a red beak. It is said that the bird will grow attached to its owners and never fly away. While the girlfriend is working as a hostess, flirting with men for money, the boyfriend decides to draw a portrait of the new family member, and disaster strikes.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 19 (March 1966).

134610.description:
A suicidal samurai and his equally despondent wife discover that fate has a different plan for them.

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 16 (December 1965).

134611.description:
A man finds a picture scroll and tries to understand the iconography. Everyone who encounters the scroll sees something different, but the initial man thinks it's a map and he follows it as such until he eventually find the scroll's artist.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 17 (January 1966).

134612.description:
Rain mysteriously falls around a particular place where a boy and his grandfather plan on going mushroom hunting the next morning...

Note: Published in Monthly Manga Garo No. 20 (April 1966).

134613.description: A penniless student yearns to buy an expensive book that he can’t afford until a small ill-gotten fortune falls into his lap.

134614.description: Shuuji Narukami, a boy with asthma, dreams of playing for Sakuragi High School Soccer Club created by his father, Ryuu. The day before the entrance ceremony, Shuuji meets Kaoru Indou, a soccer genius from Hokkaido.
synonyms: The You That Never Looks Back

134618.description:
Shizue and Chizuko are a pair of sisters and married women who have come to a summer villa for a vacation. There they meet two lost young boys who emerged from the woods.

These two sexually frustrated sisters will seduce the boys and bring them into the world of adults.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

title.native: コンデンス ワイフ

synonyms: How to Have Fun on a Weekday

134622.description:
Inside this too-cute rabbit is a painfully stubborn man?! Tatsuto Uzaki (age 46), harshly strict with both himself and others, lives with his daughter Honoka as a family of two. Uzaki holds only contempt for the helpless and weak-willed animals known as housepets, while Honoka has always wanted a pet of her own, and one day this conflict of opinion explodes into a huge fight. Hoping to make up, Uzaki visits a pet shop, but the moment he picks up a rabbit to bring home, he gets struck by lightning...!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

134624.description: A romantic drama is set in Camelot Garden, a boys' dormitory ruled by social rank and privilege at an illusionary boarding school, about one of its residents, a boy named Ryuu, who spies on someone he loves.

134626.description: Gong In-Ju was dumped by her boyfriend, Ahn Geu-Rim, for no reason. In-Ju, who has been living while depending on Ahn Geu-Rim all this time, feels the emptiness of losing Geu-Rim and plans to get him back. The first thing in the plan is to arouse Geu-Rim's jealousy! To do this, she tries to seduce Seo-Yun, a handsome junior she met during a volunteer work, but Seo-Yun had a crush on someone else... What will the end be for the two people who form an alliance to win over love...?

134627.description:
The meeting of a man who has an alluring scent and one that has no scent at all!

(Source. Toomics)

134629.description:
A thrilling fantasy that transcends time and space for two men and a nine-tailed fox! Sung-Woo is a third-generation billionaire. Upon opening a jewelry box his grandfather left him, he wakes up Bi, the nine-tailed fox sealed in a marble. Equally absurd? Bi comes from the ancient Joseon dynasty of Korea!? Sung-Woo finds it difficult to soothe the outraged Bi and calls his cousin Yoo-Sung to help. Although Yoo-Sung has never been greedy, he feels a strong possessiveness for the first time with Bi. Yoo-Sung takes Bi back to his home, kicking off a wonderful love triangle!

(Source: Lezhin)

134631.description:
The destiny of the beautiful Devil suddenly appeared! Is his heart just too obsessed with appearance? Or true love?

In the land of Fire, there was a young man who sold mats to overcome poverty. One day, He came across a beautiful demon. His life suddenly burned like a scorching flame.

134633.description:
To become a god in bed, all you need to do is accept female guests into your guest house!

(Source: Toomics)

134634.description:
He's a boy band idol who appeared to be a cold beauty, struggling to restrain himself to stay in character. He seems like a young and innocent pretty boy on the outside, was actually completely different from that… Despite looking down on each other, and arguing in every possible situation, they were compelled to pair up in order to achieve the popularity that they needed?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

134635.description:
Killed on the battlefield without glory to his name, Yuseong Dan receives an opportunity to grow stronger with a strange quest and level system. But each quest he’s forced to fight only seems to be getting harder and harder. Can he level up enough to avoid the same miserable ending and become the powerful hero he wishes to be?

(Source: WEBTOON)

134636.description:
What does a bellboy do when the vvip guest at his hotel starts showing interest in him?

(Source: Toomics)

When did I start to dislike "blue"?

An exciting but unmentionable part-time job; the spirits-dispelling rites that can touch souls; the destined encounter... and someone hiding in the darkness.

The story begins when a girl arrives at the door of top book designer Tatsumi, asking for a job as an assistant. Thanks to her cleaning of his house, Tatsumi is able to take another look at his worn-out life. The manga is a story of a book designer who lives near the Chuo line of trains with his cat.

134663.description: A kunoichi plays a long con against a brutish samurai lord, spending years in his detention to fulfill her contract.

134664.description: A grisly tale of a crematorium worker who burned his coworker alive in the furnace, later confessing in a letter to a boy who was accidentally given some of the wrong remains.

134665.description:
An unsuccessful manga artist with only 300 yen to his name goes on a stroll, there he finds three men playing a game of chance and decides to join in.

Note: Published in COMIC Baku No. 1 (June 1984).

134666.description:
Kou and Maki have been best friends since preschool. Fifteen years later, they are both delinquents that somehow end up in fights. Kou is cool, stoic, and always hangs around Maki. A running skit among their friends is that Kou and Maki are an item and that Kou is head over heels for his pink-haired partner. But... does that joke hold any truth in reality?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Going all out to relieve her discontent. ♥

134668.description:
Harukawa, an an office worker, loves going on outings. Akiyama, a novelist, just wants to laze about in the house all day. This is the life of two women who live together in Shiga Prefecture, going on laid-back outings that are more relaxed than a trip, but more exciting than a stroll!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

134669.description: Note: Promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
synonyms: Don't Be Obsessed With a Spirit Like Me

134671.description:
To save my family from certain doom, I offered to become the Emperor’s secretary in place of my clumsy brother. I excelled at work in my previous life… to the point of overworking myself, but that’s beside the point! I know I got this. I served the tyrant emperor perfectly, down to a T, so now I can quit working and the plot can continue on. But when I asked to resign, he retorted, “Do you want to die?” Your Majesty, you’ve always been disinterested in people, why are you holding me back? Please let me live the rest of my life peacefully!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: chapter count includes 7 side-stories and a prologue.

134672.description:
Witches love their familiars! When Lena gets a new pet, she expresses her love for her by sharing one of a witches most important tools. Her broom!

(Source: Lilyka)

134673.description:
A terrorist attack on a date?!

In the year 2099, science has advanced beyond belief. Jane, the school's resident loser and daughter of the world's leading robotics engineer, finally lands a date with her crush on New Year's Eve. But her world is turned upside down when terror strikes, and she discovers the truth about her past.

(Source: Manta)

134677.description:
The day Yeon-U’s contract marriage came to an end was also the day that she witnessed her soon-to-be ex-husband, Seon-Jae, die right in front of her eyes. But when a twist of fate has her travel 100 days back in time before the tragic accident, she decides to do everything she can to stop the accident from happening. With a second chance to make things right, Yeon-U is determined to make sure that, this time around, they get their happy ending.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: En busca de un final feliz

Otaku Oh Deok-Hae, who is a regular salaryman, has been suffering a lot lately. This is all because the boss at his company looks just like his favorite character, Cain!
The boss has a nice family, a beautiful face, amazing fashion sense, and great work ethics. Sadly, he doesn't like Deok-Hae.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

134679.description:
Love is about forgiveness...

Reina Higashiyama, who runs a ballet company, plans a full-length production of "Giselle" as an ambitious presentation comparable to the original performance. With IT company president Kazuya Takato as her patron, Reina happily begins her rehearsals...

Wilis is the spirit of a woman who died just before her marriage. She appeared in the classic ballet masterpiece "Giselle".

(Source: Kadokawa)

The minor immortal Hua Yu who lives in the Ninth Kingdom along the Cloud River, gave up immortality and descended to the mortal realm in search of her beloved. Getting to know him again, starting as strangers, becoming familiar, then adventuring together until finally, that fateful moment when he will remember. Will that cold face be able to sense the feelings in the maiden's heart?

(Source: QQ, translated)

134684.description: The story tells of our male protagonist Xia Tian who just turned 19 years old. Suddenly, he found himself on a strange road and barely escaped from a truck that almost killed him. Then he was picked up by a luxury car on the way to Jianghai City, all whilst not remembering anything except the name Qiao Xiaoqiao...

Keita loves cats and hates spiders, when he found a strange creature that's a fusion of the two! For some reason, the spider-kitty becomes attached to him, and he feels compelled to take care of it. And that's only the start of the extraordinary events! The start of a supernatural slice-of-life story!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

134686.description: An unknown alien enemy attacks the Earth and the armies on Earth must try to hold off the invasion. It is based on the story for the SNES shoot-em up game Super Aleste.

134687.description: The shy Yuki meets the old painter Honda. Through painting, she awakens to new possibilities.

134688.description:
As a half-shut-in who lives alone, Gu BiQiong's only goal in life is to work hard so he can pay his living expenses...
However, one day, a cute, long-legged girl who calls herself a Mohist Mechanical Puppet suddenly comes looking for him. With tears in her eyes, she hugs him and says: "Waaaah, Sect Master! We've been separated for many thousands of years, but now I've finally found you! Let's rebuild our sect and conquer the world..."

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Sect Master is Not an Idiot!

title.english: The Sect Master Is Not an Idiot!

134689.description: Shuntaro Akagi works as an elite businessman at a general trading company in central Tokyo. He's been chosen as the personnel department head while still in his mid-thirties, and expects to soon marry his sweetheart, Asuka. Both his public and private lives seems picture perfect for continuing success... or so it seems. But quite by chance, this contented Shuntaro has to help out at Asuka's family business in the Tsukiji Fish Market, the well-known middle trader shop called "Uotatsu". However, the fish market is a place where competition is fiercely fought within the long-established conventions held by the expert traders. This total novice, Shuntaro, doesn't stand a chance against them. And of course he isn't a discerning judge of fish. The one and only thing he does have is an ability to distinguish good taste with his tongue. Shuntaro's days of fierce battle begin!!

134690.description:
The story takes place at the Kitashiro School for the Deaf (called the Fukuri School for the Deaf in the manga), a school for deaf children with rubella, which actually existed in Okinawa Prefecture.

A moving story of overcoming disability and dedicating youth for baseball. Written with deep understanding and love, this work has contributed to the popularisation of sign language.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

134691.description:
The flawless Prince Nazaire changes schools in hopes of wooing a bride… only to encounter the tyrant Cassius Li! At first, the two cannot stand one another, as they constantly infuriate each other. Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Torn between love and duty, can the prince and tyrant reach their happily ever after?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

134692.description:
Orr was cursed after drawing a legendary sword from the ground which made him lose all emotions. On his way to defeat the Demon King, he had to stay at a village to resolve the cases many people simply vanishing. In that place, he met Mayim, a mountain deity who seemed to be connected to the abductions?

Ami has a special ability: she can see the dirty fantasies of virginal men. When Bom applies for a job at the SW Publishing Company, she meets Haneul, a frosty yet capable department head. Haneul has a rare condition which prevents him from recognizing the faces of women. Mamori Ichifuku loves daydreaming about his two male classmates (Taku and Kazuhito) falling in love with each other. Taku ends up helping him practice, but Mamori realizes this means less time for those two to hang out!!! And, Taku starts trying to get closer to Mamori... why can't he just follow the plot script Mamori had figured out in his head...!? All Mamori wanted to be was a fan...

She boldly declares she's going to become an extrovert, and she challenges Yoshida to do the same...!? But instead of competing with the other princesses, her goal was to check out the library of the dragon palace, the largest in the world. Seven days after arriving, Ruying was reading alone in the library when she was caught by a handsome man from the Dragon Clan. He suddenly kissed her and said, "I've finally found you," as Ruiying's life was about to change forever.

“Qiao Yu, if I'm unable to avoid meeting you again, this time, I'll make sure to protect my heart and not fall in love with you!”

After Xiao Qing walks in on his boyfriend of ten years with another man, he storms out, only to meet his end. But when Qing reincarnates and travels to a time before he meets Qiao Yu, he vows to protect himself against his former love. How will he change his fate?

"I would like for us to be friends... perhaps even lovers?" "Wh-... a noblewoman shouldn't say such things...!" The noble daughter of duke Giljester, Velarde, has drawn in and formed an alliance with Noin, an assassin targeting her father. With memories of her past life driving her to wear the mask of a villainess, Velarde is set on finding a way to be free of the antiquated responsibilities thrusted onto women in this world. Noin, finding himself drawn to this unique girl, allows himself to be placed under her influence. Can the two of them attain freedom from the powers that be and find the revenge that Velarde craves for her brother and father? And what of the feelings Noin may have for her...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

"When we die, will we become electricity?" A heartwarming SF tale!

A doctor, Duncan McDougall, once postulated a theory: "The soul weighs 21 grams." The theory, which had long been regarded as an empty fantasy with no basis in reality, has been proven true after several decades. Scientific and technological advances have revealed that the human body releases a small amount of an unknown gas after death. It turned out that this small amount of stable energy could be captured and used to generate electricity, revolutionizing human life...

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)
